_formEndpoint: REQUIRED before go-live. Formspree: create a form at formspree.io whose recipient is info@maksims.ee, then paste its endpoint here — it looks like https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxxx. Set company.formProvider to "Formspree" at the same time. The form markup already suits Formspree: the field named `email` becomes the Reply-To, `_subject` sets the subject line, and app.js sends Accept: application/json so the visitor stays on the page. Nothing else needs changing. While this is empty the build warns and the form falls back to mailto: so no enquiry is silently lost.

company._source: regCode and vatNumber per the Estonian e-Business Register (ariregister.rik.ee/est/company/10038498), registered name Osaühing Maksims. Leaving either empty makes the footer, contact card and JSON-LD omit it.
company._formProvider: Name of the form service that receives submissions, e.g. "Formspree". Set this together with formEndpoint: the privacy policy names it as a processor. While it is empty the policy states that the form opens the visitor's own mail client and no third party is involved — which is what actually happens in the mailto fallback.
